review.notes: Normalized full-text diff of every physical PDF page against the OCR markdown, followed by targeted renders. Verified visually at 110-130 dpi: pages 17, 30, 31, 36, 37, 38 (figure labels and heading levels), 150-dpi bottom strips of 15, 19, 27, 40 (footnote bodies), 300-dpi crops of p.17 equation (4), p.42 'Geneval', p.43 'Shenghai Yuan', p.45 'Seededit 3.0' and 'Shuting Wang'. Table numbers for Tables 2-15 (physical pages 20-26) were cross-checked as a numeric multiset against the PDF text layer; residual deltas are body-text mentions and figure-internal axis labels, not missing cells. Equations (1)-(8) all survive with tags. Figure-internal prompt-box transcriptions around Figures 13 and 18-28 exist only inside embedded figures and were left unchanged apart from heading demotions.

patches.evidence: These are the small bold per-case labels printed inside Figures 20-28 on the rendered pages (phys. p.30/31/33/36/38 verified visually; e.g. p.38 shows three 'Input prompt' labels for the Figure 28 rotation cases), not document section headings. The OCR promoted them to level-2 headings, creating empty 'Input prompt' sections in the reader outline; they are demoted to the same plain-paragraph style the other figure labels already use.

Rendered physical p.31 (Figure 21) shows this text belongs to the figure content (model-output imagery and its label bar), not a section heading; demoted to plain text between the embedded output images.
Rendered physical p.37 (Figure 27) shows 'Input Image' as a column label inside the chained-editing figure, verified visually; demoted from heading to plain text.
Rendered physical p.37 (Figure 27) shows both 'Input chained prompt 1:' boxes as figure-internal labels (robe and paper-boat cases), verified visually; demoted from heading to plain text.
Rendered physical p.37 (Figure 27) shows both 'Input chained prompt 2:' boxes as figure-internal labels, verified visually; demoted from heading to plain text.

Rendered physical p.17 shows '(A) Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)' as an unnumbered bold sub-heading subordinate to '4.2.2 Reinforcement Learning (RL)'; the OCR gave it the same level-2 heading as its parent section. Only the level is demoted to level 3.

Rendered physical p.17 shows '(B) Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)' as an unnumbered bold sub-heading subordinate to '4.2.2 Reinforcement Learning (RL)'; demoted from level 2 to level 3 to match the printed hierarchy.

Rendered physical p.17 equation (4) prints an upright roman 'mean' in the numerator; OCR split it into spaced letters 'm e a n'. The patch only removes the inter-letter spacing and marks the upright operator, matching the PDF and the \mathrm style used elsewhere.
Rendered physical p.17 equation (4) prints an upright roman 'std' in the denominator; OCR split it into spaced letters 's t d'. Same repair as the numerator patch.

unresolved.evidence: The Chinese text blocks that transcribe what the generated images show (e.g. the glass-panel text under Figure 21) are OCR of figure content and contain their own reading errors; the embedded figures display the originals, so the transcriptions were left unchanged.

The demoted 'QWEN' line next to the Figure 21 outputs may be a misreading of the 'Qwen-Image' label bar; the embedded image shows its own label, so only the heading level was repaired, not the wording.
